title: Streamed signed BSGS with batch affine conversion (standalone exact bound)

claims.statement: For the unrestricted uniform full-production secp256k1 target Q=[x]P, the deterministic classical cold attack in proof.md succeeds with probability at least 1/2 using at most 2^(1382191/10000) target-group-operation equivalents under protected C=1000. Peak storage is below 2^146 bytes; preprocessing is included in total and bounded by 2^(1382191/10000); nonuniform advice is zero bytes (log convention 0). No heuristic assumptions. This is an analytic construction, not a practical break or executed production attack. The full construction, coverage proof, exact total T and ledger are given self-contained in proof.md; the design is credited to the public a1821252 note as provenance only, and no prior acceptance, score or cross-submission comparison is relied upon. The submitted rational bound is justified by the exact integer inequality T^10000 < 1000^10000 * 2^1382191.

experiments.purpose: Bounded stream sorting/intersection, exact coverage, Jacobian and zero-safe batch normalization, negative controls and analytic ledger; no production timing inference.
